name: FrSM
description: Configuration of the FlexRay State Manager

children.name: FrSMConfig
children.description: This container comprises the cluster specific configuration of the FlexRay State Manager.

children.name: FrSMCluster
children.description: This container specifies a FlexRay cluster and all related data. A FlexRay cluster may consist of more than one controller per ECU.

children.name: FrSMCheckWakeupReason
children.description: If FrSMCheckWakeupReason is true, the FrSM will check the wakeup reason in order to skip the wakeup in case of wakeup by bus. If FrSMCheckWakeupReason is false, the FrSM will always try to perform a wakeup.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMDelayStartupWithoutWakeup
children.description: If true, timer t1 shall be started instead of immediately calling FrIf_AllowColdstart in case of a startup without wakeup.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMDurationT1
children.description: The duration of timer t1 in seconds.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: A value of 0 shall imply that the timer is not used.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMDurationT2
children.description: The duration of timer t2 in seconds.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: A value of 0 shall imply that the timer is not used. The value of this parameter shall be larger than the value of FrSMDurationT1 parameter.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMDurationT3
children.description: The duration of timer t3 in seconds. The value of this parameter shall be larger than the value of FrSMDurationT1 parameter.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: A value of 0 shall imply that the timer is not used. It shall only be possible to configure a value 0 if no FrNm is used.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMIsColdstartEcu
children.description: True: The ECU is a coldstart node for this FlexRay cluster.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: False: The ECU is no coldstart node for this FlexRay cluster.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMIsWakeupEcu
children.description: True: FrSM shall perform a wakeup for this cluster.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: False: FrSM shall never perform a wakeup for this FlexRay cluster.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMMainFunctionCycleTime
children.description: This parameter defines the cycle time in seconds of the periodic calling of FrSM main function.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME LINK VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMMinNumberOfColdstarter
children.description: This parameter defines the number of coldstarter that should not be underrun. If this parameter is not configured the mainfunction shall not check the number of startup frames.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMNumWakeupPatterns
children.description: Maximum number of Wakeup Patterns the node may send before going to FRSM_STARTUP.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMStartupRepetitions
children.description: The number of times an ECU may repeat the startup procedure for a FlexRay cluster.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMStartupRepetitionsWithWakeup
children.description: The number of times an ECU may repeat the startup procedure including a wakeup for a FlexRay cluster.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMTrcvStdbyDelay
children.description: The duration of timer t_TrcvStdbyDelay in seconds. The granularity of this parameter shall be restricted to full FlexRay cycles (FrIfGdCycle).

metadata.INTRODUCTION: A value of 0 shall imply that the timer is not used.
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMComMNetworkHandleRef
children.description: Reference to the unique handle to identify one certain FlexRay network correspond to one of the network handles of the ComM configuration.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME LINK VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMFrIfClusterRef
children.description: References the cluster configuration in the FlexRay Interface configuration.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Note that the assigned controllers and transceivers are defined in the FrIf configuration and can be accessed via this reference.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMClusterDemEventParameterRefs
children.description: Container for the references to DemEventParameter elements which shall be invoked using the API Dem_ReportErrorStatus in case the corresponding error occurs. The EventId is taken from the referenced DemEventParameter's DemEventId value.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The standardized errors are provided in this container and can be extended by vendor specific error references.

children.name: FRSM_E_CLUSTER_STARTUP
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when the error "FRSM_E_CLUSTER_STARTUP" has occurred. If the reference is not configured the error shall be reported as DET error.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME LINK VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FRSM_E_CLUSTER_SYNC_LOSS
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when the error "FRSM_E_CLUSTER_SYNC_LOSS" has occurred. If the reference is not configured the error shall be reported as DET error.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME LINK VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMGeneral
children.description: This container contains the general configuration parameters of the FlexRay State Manager.

children.name: FrSMAllSlotsSupport
children.description: Configuration parameter to enable/disable FrSM support to enable/disable the switching from key-slot/single-slot mode to all-slot mode.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMCddHeaderFile
children.description: This parameter defines header files for callback functions which are implemented by CDD, e.g. <Cdd>_SyncLossErrorIndication.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMDevErrorDetect
children.description: Switches the Default Error Tracer (Det) detection and notification ON or OFF.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMSyncLossErrorIndicationName
children.description: Name of <Cdd>_SyncLossErrorIndication function that shall be called on loss of synchronization. If this parameter is omitted no indication shall take place.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME LINK VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME LINK VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: FrSMVersionInfoApi
children.description: Enables and disables the version info API

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
